subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become a supported public Plugin SDK/runtime contract for owner plugins, or should this Teams fix use a narrower bundled/internal seam?
rationale: The bug and technical implementation are well proven, but expanding the public Plugin SDK creates a permanent compatibility commitment that requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK API
options.body: Merge the current contract because it centralizes session rotation, enforces physical-owner coordination, and has generic documentation and race coverage.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Retain the Teams behavior but move reset access behind a bundled or internal seam to avoid creating a third-party API commitment.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK API
recommendation.body: Merge the current contract because it centralizes session rotation, enforces physical-owner coordination, and has generic documentation and race coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He directly reviewed and refined the Teams lifecycle scope on this branch and is the strongest available decision-owner signal.
